rice.ideal_soil: Clayey, loam, or clay-loam soils with good water retention.
rice.water_requirements: High (Needs standing water). Approx 1500-2500 mm rainfall.
rice.tips: Maintain proper flooding during early stages. Ensure good drainage before harvest.

wheat.ideal_soil: Well-drained fertile loamy and clayey soils.
wheat.tips: Avoid waterlogging. Requires cool growing season and bright sunshine at ripening.

maize.water_requirements: Moderate to High. Approx 500-800 mm rainfall.
maize.tips: Sensitive to waterlogging. Ensure adequate nitrogen fertilizer.

cotton.ideal_soil: Deep black soils (Regur) or alluvial soils.
cotton.tips: Needs 210 frost-free days. Avoid rain during boll bursting.
